t: Proclaimed a republic by the conservative caudillo Rafael Carrera in 1847, it is the most populous country of Central America.
Liberal dictators built a coffee economy on forced Maya labour and gave the United Fruit Company great privileges.
A CIA-backed coup in 1954 ended a decade of reform; civil war in 1960–1996 killed about 200,000 people, most of them Maya.
dyk: A young Argentine doctor, Ernesto Guevara, was living in Guatemala City when the CIA-backed coup toppled Árbenz in 1954, an experience that radicalised the future ‘Che’.
